The '''Toydarian royal delegation''' was a commission of individuals from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Toydaria/Legends|Toydaria]]. Led by [[King/Legends|King]] [[Katuunko/Legends|Katuunko]], the delegation met with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] on behalf of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], to negotiate a possible alliance between the Toydarians and the Republic. The meeting was supposed to take place in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] on [[Rugosa/Legends|Rugosa]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] not far from Toydaria. However, before Yoda could [[Battle of Rugosa/Legends|rendezvous with the delegation]], Katuunko was approach by an emissary of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]. Sent by CIS leader [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], Ventress attempted to waylay Yoda with a [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] while she presented Katuunko with the Confederacy's own proposal, one that offered both solidarity and protection from her superiors. Yoda managed to defeat Ventress' [[Droid/Legends|automatons]] with the assistance of the small contingent of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] that accompanied him to Rugosa. Impressed, Katuunko declined Dooku's proposition, in favor of Master Yoda's offer to align with the Republic.
